claude_proposed_widenings.name: stateful_container_item
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item's core mechanic is owning extradimensional stored contents with capacity, retrieval procedure, temporary disablement, and internal air supply. That is not a passive grant or an activated ability.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The bag can hold up to 500 pounds, not exceeding a volume of 64 cubic feet. Retrieving an item from the bag requires a Utilize action.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: extradimensional_collision_gate
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item has a trigger driven by interaction with another extradimensional space that destroys items, opens a temporary gate, and exiles nearby creatures. No existing magic-item family expresses that event structure honestly.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Placing a Bag of Holding inside an extradimensional space created by a Handy Haversack, Portable Hole, or similar item instantly destroys both items and opens a gate to the Astral Plane.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: item_destruction.physical_or_state_trigger
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Current destruction policies only cover charge exhaustion. Bag of Holding is destroyed by overload, piercing, tearing, or the extradimensional collision event instead.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If the bag is overloaded, pierced, or torn, it is destroyed, and its contents are scattered in the Astral Plane.
